metadata.syllabus_name: Advanced Generative AI_Trí tuệ Nhân tạo Tạo sinh Nâng cao
metadata.description: Advanced Generative AI (AGA) studies how modern large language models (LLMs) and the generative-AI stack are built, adapted, evaluated, and deployed. This technology is one of the most rapidly evolving areas of machine learning, and demand is growing for professionals able to construct, fine-tune, align, and ship production-quality LLM-based systems. The course covers transformer architectures and data preparation, foundational and transformer-based language modelling, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA), advanced alignment (RLHF, PPO, DPO), and the design of LLM-powered applications using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, and AI agents. By the end of this specialization, students will be ready to design generative-AI applications that perform text generation, classification, translation, retrieval-augmented question answering, and build LLM-powered agents.

clos.clo_details: Distinguish the major generative-AI model families and implement tokenization and PyTorch data pipelines.
Build NLP systems using foundational language-modelling techniques
Apply transformer LLMs to generation, classification, translation, and understanding tasks.
Adapt LLMs for domain tasks using PEFT, instruction tuning, and alignment
Design, build, and deploy production LLM applications using RAG, vector stores, and agent patterns.

schedule.topic: Specialization Introduction Generative AI and LLMs: Architecture and Data Preparation - Generative AI architectures and models (RNNs, transformers, GANs, VAEs, diffusion) Offline 1: Introduction to the online course AGA301c
- Tokenization techniques with NLTK, spaCy, Hugging Face - PyTorch data loaders and pipelines for generative AI
Gen AI Foundational Models for NLP & Language Understanding: - N-gram language models - Word embeddings: Word2Vec, GloVe - Document classification
- Sequence-to-sequence models - Encoder-decoder RNNs - Introduction to attention mechanisms
Generative AI Language Modeling with Transformers: - Transformer architecture in depth - Positional encoding; multi-head self-attention - Encoder vs decoder; causal vs masked attention
- Applying transformers to translation, classification, and text generation - Decoding and sampling strategies
Generative AI Engineering and Fine-Tuning Transformers: - Pretraining objectives (MLM, CLM) - Transfer learning - Hugging Face fine-tuning pipelines
- Parameter-efficient fine-tuning: LoRA, QLoRA, adapters - Quantization for fine-tuning on consumer GPUs
Generative AI Advance Fine-Tuning for LLMs: - LLMs as policies - Instruction tuning; reward modelling; preference data
- Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and PPO - Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) - Evaluation of aligned models
Fundamentals of AI Agents Using RAG and LangChain: - In-context learning and advanced prompting - LangChain components, chains, agents - Embeddings, vector stores, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
Project: Generative AI Applications with RAG and LangChain (Capstone RAG-based Q&A system) Offline 2: Review Generative AI Engineering with LLMs Specialization
